supporting_observations.claim: The repeated outbound connections in the alert window are proxy CONNECT requests to the approved RouteWise update host, update.routewise.com. They occur from 13:38:37 through 14:08:08 at roughly five-minute intervals.

The RouteWise updater process was created as C:\Program Files\RouteWise\routewiseupd.exe with the --background argument, and its outbound connections to the proxy are attributed to that same process and match the RouteWise update requests by time and source port.

The observed destination and recurring connection pattern are consistent with the approved RouteWise updater behavior described in the environment inventory; the available evidence supports a benign explanation for the alerted activity.
The updater process exited at 14:08:43, shortly after the last observed RouteWise update connection at 14:08:08.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec collection was unavailable on DC-COP-01 from 13:30 to 14:20 UTC due to a collection outage. This limits review of domain-controller Windows security events, but does not remove the available proxy and endpoint process/network records for the alerted connections.
The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnels, so the evidence provided does not reveal the encrypted application payload.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish what content, if any, was exchanged inside the HTTPS tunnels or whether an update was downloaded or installed.
The available records do not include a hash or signature validation for the RouteWise updater binary, so its authenticity is not independently established by these logs.
unrelated_findings: A Dropbox updater made an outbound connection to desktop.dropbox.com; Dropbox is not an approved file-sharing or cloud-storage service in the inventory. Review separately. (T136-00254, T136-00255)

GlobalProtect PanGPA.exe was launched on a host in an environment with no VPN and where remote administration is restricted to WS-PBECKER-01. The records establish process launch, not a VPN connection; review separately. (T136-00098, T136-00100, T136-00101)
